item.title: BEE Aware of Spuriousness: Mechanistic Interpretability for Fine Tuning Foundation Models
item.description: BEE reveals spurious correlations learned during fine tuning by analyzing classifier weight drift and embedding geometry. A mechanistic interpretability view of why shortcuts form, plus visual evidence from ImageNet and beyond.
